features.title: Core Compression Engine
acceptance: Compress JSON input by 60-95% with token-count preservation
Compress plain text/code by 20% with semantic preservation
Deterministic offline algorithm, no LLM required
Exported as Python library with CLI entrypoint

features.title: FastAPI Proxy Server
acceptance: Accept POST /compress with JSON/text payload
Return compressed output with metadata (ratio, tokens saved)
Health check endpoint

features.title: React Compression Dashboard
acceptance: Paste/code upload input, see compressed output side-by-side
Show compression ratio, token savings, before/after preview
Copy/download compressed result

features.title: MCP Server Integration
acceptance: Expose compress tool via MCP protocol
Works with Claude Desktop / MCP clients

features.title: Compression History & Analytics
acceptance: Persist compression operations to SQLite with metadata
API endpoints for history listing with filtering and pagination
Analytics summary endpoint (totals, by type, by algorithm)
Frontend History panel with table view and analytics summary
Clear history functionality

features.title: OIDC/Keycloak Authentication
acceptance: Authorization code flow with PKCE
Role-based access (viewer/operator/admin)
Session management with HttpOnly cookies

features.title: Docker Compose with Keycloak
acceptance: Backend, frontend, Keycloak services
Persistent volumes for DB and Keycloak
Healthchecks on all services
